articles.title: Man Utd extend Bruno Fernandes contract until 2028
articles.summary: Manchester United have officially activated a clause in their captain Bruno Fernandes' contract, successfully extending his stay at Old Trafford until the summer of 2028. This move secures the midfielder's future with the club and prevents him from becoming a free agent in the near future, ensuring leadership stability under their current management.

articles.title: Renee Slegers leaves Arsenal after difficult start
articles.summary: Arsenal have parted ways with head coach Renee Slegers by mutual consent following a disappointing beginning to the current football season. Slegers departs eighteen months after guiding the team to a Champions League victory, as the club looks for new leadership to turn around their recent underwhelming performances in the league.

articles.title: Emery praises Alejandro Garnacho despite squad selection snub
articles.summary: Aston Villa manager Unai Emery has publicly praised Alejandro Garnacho for displaying a fantastic attitude following a recent selection snub. However, the Spanish boss suggested that other members of the squad currently rank ahead of the young player when it comes to earning a regular spot in the starting lineup.

articles.title: Tottenham winger Savio ruled out of festive fixtures
articles.summary: Tottenham Hotspur winger Savio is set to miss the club's busy schedule of Christmas fixtures due to an injury setback. Manager Roberto de Zerbi has confirmed that the player could potentially face a lengthy spell on the sidelines, with an expected recovery period lasting up to eighty days.

articles.title: French President Macron condemns violence at European matches
articles.summary: Violent fan clashes have marred several European football fixtures, prompting French President Emmanuel Macron to strongly condemn the trouble that occurred during Marseille's home game against Levski Sofia. The incidents have raised fresh concerns regarding security and fan behavior at major continental club matches across Europe.

articles.title: Renee Slegers leaves Arsenal role after winless run
articles.summary: Renee Slegers has departed her position as Arsenal Women's head coach by mutual consent following a dismal run of results. The team currently languishes in sixth place in the Women's Super League after recording six consecutive home draws, leaving them trailing far behind league leaders Chelsea in the title race.

articles.title: Manchester United extend Fernandes deal to avoid exit
articles.summary: Manchester United have triggered a contract extension clause for captain Bruno Fernandes, tying him to the club until 2028. By exercising this option, the club successfully avoids the risk of losing him as a free agent. Meanwhile, manager Mauricio Pochettino warned his squad that they should not expect him to be overly nice.

articles.title: Tarik Muharemovic shines after Leeds United transfer
articles.summary: Defender Tarik Muharemovic has emerged as one of the standout signings of the Premier League season following his move from Sassuolo. As his high-flying Leeds United side prepares to host Coventry, the Bosnia centre-half reflects on his football journey, learning from defensive greats, and the strong support of his refugee parents.

articles.title: Borussia Dortmund chase long-awaited Bundesliga title
articles.summary: Niko Kovac's Borussia Dortmund side currently leads the Bundesliga standings, presenting them with a golden opportunity to claim the German championship for the first time in fifteen years. With traditional rivals Bayern Munich dealing with vulnerabilities, Dortmund hope to avoid past heartbreak and finally secure the league crown.

articles.title: Eric Cantona reflects on career in new documentary
articles.summary: Manchester United icon Eric Cantona has opened up about his complex personality, his deep bond with English football, and his infamous kung-fu kick in a gripping new documentary. The unrepentant former player candidly discusses his mixture of angelic and dark instincts during his illustrious and controversial playing career.

articles.title: Charles Leclerc chases Mercedes after Qatar practice
articles.summary: Ferrari driver Charles Leclerc believes an unexpected performance outlier has given Mercedes a massive advantage at the Qatar Grand Prix. His comments follow dominant practice sessions where Kimi Antonelli and George Russell comfortably led the timesheets for the Silver Arrows.

articles.title: Phil Taylor announces permanent retirement from darts
articles.summary: Legendary darts player Phil Taylor has confirmed that he is quitting competitive darts for good following his recent comeback. The multiple-time world champion stated that he has absolutely no future plans to come out of retirement again, marking the definitive end of his iconic career.

articles.title: Anthony Joshua checks on Tyson Fury fight status
articles.summary: Tyson Fury's manager, Spencer Brown, has revealed that heavyweight rival Anthony Joshua personally called to verify whether their upcoming fight was still happening. The inquiry followed unconfirmed rumors and claims that the Gypsy King had supposedly been diagnosed with schizophrenia ahead of the bout.

articles.title: Kimi Antonelli leads Mercedes practice dominance in Qatar
articles.summary: Kimi Antonelli outpaced his Mercedes teammate George Russell in both Friday practice sessions at the Qatar Grand Prix, capping off a commanding day for the team. The young Italian's impressive performances highlight a dominant showing from Mercedes as they prepare for the weekend's main competitive events.
